name: Quick Links Card
description: A title, text and a list of links. The card isn't a link itself, so it has no hover colors: each link is its own.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): 16px corners, 24px card padding, the 8px space below the title, the 16px space below the text, the Cloud fill and Tinta text
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365's card designs: the quick links and the call to action
The AZ Digital UX Design System Figma file's Card component (2026-10-28): 12px between links
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2273 (closes #2271): 18px body text; az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2286: its 28px line height
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

text.description: The card's text, below the title and above the links.

font.size.$description: Card text size: the same as body text.

line-height.$description: Card text line height: the same as body text.

link.description: A link in the list: one per line, underlined, in Proxima Nova Condensed. There's no font family token for it: az.font-family.sans-serif-condensed is Proxima Nova Extra Condensed.

gap.$description: Space between the links in a list.
